models.model: Coherent dictionary operations derived from reviewed control flow; no native filesystem execution
models.enumeration_scope: 12 depth-first leaf orders; eight independent copy results; all deletes succeed
models.crash_scope: Boundary cuts followed by one reboot with successful copies; not within-call/flush/NAND faults

config_counterexample.scope: Successful original backup, cut before format, staged upgrade still present

invariants_required_for_fix: Retain extraction receipt and all needed source files until full installed-file verification
Propagate copy/enumeration/directory errors through recursion, staging caller and manager startup
Publish Version_Info only after required payloads are verified; preserve a separate recovery receipt
Keep a verified configuration backup across format/restore failures and reboot
Do not treat an existing scan marker as proof that a backup is complete or expendable
models.not_implemented: No guarded or transactional firmware patch is written by this model

load_error_actions: Clear image holder; set update flag and counter to 1
missing_micom_image.meaning: CE attempts a control/load-error transfer even without firmware.hex; MCU meaning and restart are open

contracts.marker_generic_move: Processed as an ordinary root file by recursive move; no filename exemption
contracts.final_delete: 0x153d0 calls recursive deletion regardless of copy results or missing extraction marker
contracts.final_copy: 0x1837c CopyFile; 0x183a0 progress store in DeleteFile delay slot; no CopyFile BOOL gate
contracts.recursive_status: No usable success/failure propagated through the reviewed void recursion/caller chain
contracts.config_preformat_backup: 0x15198 backup then 0x151a8 format, with no backup-status gate
contracts.startup_launch: 0x12d80 launches MicomManager after staging function without a result gate
contracts.firmware_self_update: 0x17530 calls two MoveFile operations without checking either result

limitations: All control-flow claims apply to the pinned updater; current unit hashes remain unknown
Dictionary models are counterexamples under stated assumptions, not CE/NAND/TFAT emulation
Actual enumeration order, free space, sharing locks, driver errors and write durability remain unmeasured
Repair requirements are a local design; no installer-reliability patch has been built or flashed
